# Ridhima Foundation

> Ridhima Foundation (रिधिमा फाउंडेशन) is a 12A and 80G registered women's health NGO in New Delhi, India, founded by AIIMS-trained gynaecologist Dr. Deepika Singh with co-founder Dr. Raj Kumar Singh. It provides free medical camps, cancer screening, menstrual hygiene and adolescent health programmes, menopause care and subsidised fertility treatment for underserved women across Delhi NCR. Tagline: "Together for a brighter tomorrow."

## Key facts

- Website: https://ridhimafoundation.org/ (Hindi: https://ridhimafoundation.org/hi/)
- Location: F-11, South Extension Part 1, New Delhi 110049, India
- Area served: Delhi NCR — urban slums and rural belts
- Registration: Sections 12A and 80G of the Income Tax Act (donations eligible for 80G tax deduction)
- Founder: Dr. Deepika Singh — MBBS, MD Obstetrics & Gynaecology (AIIMS New Delhi), MCCG (Germany)
- Co-founder: Dr. Raj Kumar Singh — MBBS, MS General Surgery (VMMC & Safdarjung Hospital), FIAGES, FMAS; bariatric, laparoscopic and laser surgeon
- Contact: WhatsApp/phone +91 8595954095, email ridhimafoundationofficial@gmail.com

## Programmes

- Project Ridhima Outreach — free gynaecology and fertility OPD camps in slums and villages
- Hope for Motherhood — subsidised IVF, IUI, scans and medicines for couples facing infertility and financial stress
- Kishori Shakti — school programme on menstrual hygiene, anaemia screening and nutrition for adolescent girls
- The Pink Shield — free mammograms, pap smears and vaccination drives against breast and cervical cancer
- Inner Healing — counselling for marital stress, infertility trauma, postpartum depression and anxiety
- Graceful Aging — menopause care, bone density tests and hormonal counselling

## Other ways to help

- Volunteer (doctors, nurses, counsellors), sponsor a treatment, adopt a medical camp (CSR), or donate medicines, sanitary pads and nutritional supplements: https://ridhimafoundation.org/#contact
